whatsappMessage:
Hi Madonna Team,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.8★ reviews across 430+ happy clients on Jamal Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new client appointments.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, bridal & grooming services menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/madonna

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Madonna Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon (Madonna on Jamal Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, bridal packages, and your 4.8-star Google review showcase for clients in Fraser Road Area. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
